newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Ship sinks off HK with half-million cans of beer.
newsitem.headline: Ship sinks off HK with half-million cans of beer.

text.p: A Chinese ship carrying 480,000 cans of beer capsized off western Hong Kong, a newspaper said on Thursday, unloading the booze into the ocean, but all 10 crew members were saved.

The 700-tonne Hengtong 320 came from Zhaoqing in China's southern Guangdong province and was on its way to Nanjing, provincial capital of Jiangsu, when it went down in heavy seas on Wednesday morning, the Tin Tin Daily News said.
The crew from Fujian province, who bought the ship for a total of about 600,000 yuan (US$72,300), were plucked out of the ocean by a rescue patrol, it said. None needed hospital treatment.
Many people in Hong Kong and China are preparing to celebrate ahead of July 1 when China regains control of the British territory, ending 156 years of colonial rule.
